integrity: The proof is analytic. A standard-library checker replays the exact normalized witness and determinant/entropy gap; finite numerical output is not used to establish the all-parameter statement.
scientific_limitations: The result proves a necessary obstruction to the published whole-family equality. It does not compute the exact adaptive measurement bound or tripartite relative entropy for asymmetric members, and it does not prove sufficiency on the symmetric locus.
title: An asymmetric obstruction to the claimed \(\Omega_1\) entanglement-measurement formula
